arguments.query: SELECT status, count(*), min(order_ts), max(order_ts) FROM orders GROUP BY status
SELECT payment_status, count(*), sum(amount_twd) FROM payments GROUP BY payment_status
SELECT o.status, p.payment_status, count(*), sum(p.amount_twd) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY 1,2

SELECT o.status, count(distinct o.order_id), count(s.shipment_id), count(s.delivered_ts), count(distinct r.order_id) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY 1

SELECT count(*), sum(i.s=p.a), sum(i.s/100=p.a) FROM (SELECT order_id, sum(quantity*unit_price_cents) s FROM order_items GROUP BY 1) i JOIN (SELECT order_id, sum(amount_twd) a FROM payments WHERE payment_status="ok" GROUP BY 1) p USING(order_id)
